title: Mapes v. Metropolitan New York Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC affirmed the conviction only for failure to submit to church government and reversed the remaining judgment. It found the first four appeal specifications immaterial or insufficient, but found merit in the evidentiary and excessive-censure specifications. It reversed the suspension and deposition, substituted Admonition, and restored Mapes to the sacraments and ruling-elder office.
first_summary: A ruling elder appealed convictions and censures arising from his refusal to leave a closed Temporary Session meeting. The SJC affirmed only his conviction for failing to submit to church government, reversed the remaining judgment for lack of supporting evidence, and held the suspension from sacraments and deposition excessive. It substituted Admonition and restored him to the sacraments and ruling-elder office.
summary: A ruling elder appealed convictions and censures arising from his brief refusal to leave a closed Temporary Session meeting. The SJC affirmed only his conviction for failing to submit to church government, because he knowingly attended and his apology acknowledged fault; it reversed findings of dereliction, sedition, rioting, and the balance for lack of supporting evidence. It rejected his first four appeal specifications, but held suspension and deposition excessive, substituted Admonition, and restored both sacraments and office, although he belonged to no particular Session.
